3469-3488-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
3469-3488-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3469-3488-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Katsumasa.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

1251-2023-4770-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1193-4881-6909.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
1193-4881-6909.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

141-1893-2511.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1893-2511.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-5131-5315-7650--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5315-7650--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Bilbo.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

586-864-2279-3125-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2279-3125-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

3129-6441-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2021-2060-6774-7315.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1494-7720-7811.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Iron Man triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

215-539-4188-7781.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
215-539-4188-7781.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Accomplished Alchemist
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it
with two or more loyalty counters on it

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1563-3899-4094-5434.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat from step 2

5195-7495-7498.description:
Cast a copy of All Aboard by paying {U}, targeting Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve All Aboard, blinking Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, causing Skycoach Conductor to become prepared.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

974-1235-7487.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of the Smaug token and Zealous Lorecaster with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Smaug token that died and the Zealous Lorecaster token trigger.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

360-3490-4050-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-3490-4050-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

5657-5910-6489.description:
Cast Drowner of Truth by paying {4}{C}{G/U}{G/U}. Drowner of Truth and Ulalek trigger.
Holding priority, cast Nameless Inversion by paying {1}{B}, triggering Ulalek.
Resolve the Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Drowner of Truth's trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2511-6517-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2457-4289-7060.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three creature tokens.
Activate two creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

4311-5344-6349.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell from anywhere but your hand this turn.
4311-5344-6349.description:
Cast Charismatic Conqueror from the top of your library by paying {1}{W}.
Charismatic Conqueror's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 7.

3532-5078-6768-7010.notablePrerequisites:
Uthros Research Craft has at least 12 charge counters on it.
There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3532-5078-6768-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Uthros Research Craft triggers, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1671-3609-6099-6881.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters, it and Mossborn Hydra trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mossborn Hydra trigger, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Moxite Refinery by paying {2}, tapping it and removing three +1/+1 counters from Mossborn Hydra, putting three charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1671-3609-6099-6881.notes: You can remove as many +1/+1 counters from Mossborn Hydra to then place counters on Magistrate's Scepter. If you remove more than three, you may be able to forego steps 1-3 during some turns. You must ensure, however, that Mossborn Hydra will continue to have three or more +1/+1 counters on it afterwards.

1395-5078-6556.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

3204-4251-4364-4885.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
3204-4251-4364-4885.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

77-2292-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

950-4639-5475.notablePrerequisites: Fatestitcher and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
950-4639-5475.description:
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Fatestitcher triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
Forensic Researcher triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat.

4053-5256-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher does not have a counter on it.
4053-5256-5944.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with zero stun counters due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Unstoppable Slasher's power.
Repeat.

687-2034-2111-3818.notablePrerequisites: Wingrattle Scarecrow does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
687-2034-2111-3818.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow, adding {C}{C}.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability and Sengir's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Wingrattle Scarecrow trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Resolve the Sengir trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sengir.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Sengir, and both counters from Wingrattle Scarecrow.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 2-4 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 5, causing you to mill three cards and returning Wingrattle Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

539-1003-1636-5094-5196.notablePrerequisites: Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
539-1003-1636-5094-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning Phyrexian Walker to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
When Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If you control another nontoken creature without summoning sickness, this combo nets infinite mana creatures you control can produce.

57-2178-4659-4813.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has lost life this turn.
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
57-2178-4659-4813.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Famished Foragers that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Famished Foragers, adding {C}{C}.
When Famished Foragers dies, Feldon triggers, untapping Feldon.
Repeat.

380-703-2047-3129.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Miirym.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating two token copies of Astral Dragon.
The Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, creating eight token copies of any noncreature artifact you control that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger from step 2, creating four token copies of any noncreature artifact you control that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.

1365-2589-4404-5256.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Ridgescale Tusker and Corridor Monitor persist until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Corridor Monitor.
Corridor Monitor dies, triggering its persist ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ridgescale Tusker.
Ridgescale Tusker dies, triggering its persist ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Ridgescale Tusker enters the battlefield, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities, causing target player to mill cards equal to Corridor Monitor and Ridgescale Tusker's power.
Repeat.

553-1730.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
553-1730.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain seven life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Machinate by paying {1}{U}{U}, looking at the top seven cards of your library, putting Approach of the Second Sun into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

989-2579-4215.description:
Activate Verdant Eidolon for {G}, sacrificing itself and adding {G}{G}{G}.
Resolve The Cauldron of Eternity's trigger first, putting Verdant Eidolon on the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, returning Verdant Eidolon to the battlefield.
Repeat.
Once you have achieved infinite green mana, you can repeat the combo adding other colors of mana with Verdant Eidolon for infinite mana of any color.

2493-2665-3617.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Archaeomancer.
2493-2665-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
When the token Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
